facts.fact: The Government of Lesotho (via LENA) reports that MICSTI opened a two-day validation workshop in Maseru from Monday (2026-09-28) on the Electronic Transactions and Communications Bill, 2026, to gather stakeholder views before the Bill progresses through the next legislative stages; the Bill is under UNDP supervision and sponsored by MICSTI.

MICSTI's ICT Director states that the absence of a legal and regulatory framework on electronic transactions has created uncertainty for government, businesses and consumers, particularly for electronic contracts, signatures, records, online services and digital commerce.
